title: High-Flow Tub Fill: Storage Tank, Mixing Valve, and Boiler Sizing in This Old House Hot-Water System

locations.name: Downstairs storage/utility location (tank location)
locations.basis: Transcript mentions "tank downstairs" indicating location within the house; shooting location not specified.

summary: This Old House examines how to supply a large soaking tub with hot water by balancing high demand against stored energy. The host demonstrates the problem of filling a big tub fast when typical faucet aerator limits (and tub spout flow) can drive up to 10 GPM, while a compact storage volume exists. The solution combines a gas-fired condensing boiler with an internal heat exchanger that preheats water and feeds a 26-gallon stainless steel storage tank. A dedicated electric element maintains the tank, and a mixing valve enables storing more energy while providing ready hot water for the tub and other fixtures. The video frames the sizing challenge, introduces the storage-and-boiler approach, and shows how the system is configured to deliver quick tub fills without sacrificing efficiency.

sections.title: Tub Fill Challenge Setup
sections.description: Introduce the hot-water challenge of filling a large tub. The host uses GPM blocks to visualize flow limits, notes the tub spout can deliver up to ~10 GPM, and identifies the storage tank’s 26 gallons as a bottleneck, prompting the question of how to fill the tub efficiently.

sections.title: Overview of the Combined Appliance
sections.description: The host introduces the concept of a combined appliance that couples a boiler with an integrated heat exchanger to begin delivering hot water to storage.

sections.title: Heat Exchanger to Storage Tank
sections.description: Explains how the boiler’s internal heat exchanger sends heated water down to the storage tank, creating a readily available hot-water reserve for fixtures.

sections.title: Storage Tank and Standby Heat
sections.description: Details the storage tank: a stainless steel, well-insulated reservoir with an electrical element to maintain standby temperature for quick usage.

sections.title: Mixing Valve and Energy Management
sections.description: Introduces a top-mounted mixing valve that enables storing more energy and better control of distribution to hot-water outlets.

sections.title: Tub-Fill Readiness and Wrap-Up
sections.description: Concludes with the practical outcome: on-demand, ready-to-use hot water for tub fills, followed by closing remarks and calls to explore more This Old House videos.
